EXAMINER'S AMENDMENT
An examiner’s amendment to the record appears below. Should the changes and/or additions be unacceptable to applicant, an amendment may be filed as provided by 37 CFR 1.312. To ensure consideration of such an amendment, it MUST be submitted no later than the payment of the issue fee.
The application has been amended as follows:
In claim 1 “wherein said barrel assembly” is amended to --wherein said barrel adapter assembly--.
Reasons for Allowance
Claims 1-17 are allowed.
The following is an examiner’s statement of reasons for allowance:
Regarding independent claim 1, the prior art of record fails to disclose or render obvious the combination including wherein the barrel adapter assembly couples to and depth ring and said barrel assembly has a tapered downstream outer wall. Therefore, the claimed invention is new.
Regarding independent claim 11, the prior art of record fails to disclose or render obvious the combination including coupling a barrel adapter assembly to a new barrel, wherein the barrel adapter has a tapered downstream outer wall; d. coupling a housing over said barrel adapter assembly to said receiver adapter. Therefore, the claimed invention is new.
Selvetti (US 2016/0033225) in view of Hochstrate et al (US 2007/0199435) [hereinafter Hochstrate] in considered the most relevant prior art of record.   Selvetti discloses a system for a firearm, said system comprising: receiver adapter 100 configured to couple with a firearm via an adapter nut 11 (Fig. 5); a barrel adapter assembly 103 which couples to a lock ring 14a (Fig. 5); a housing (grooves in side of barrel adapter assembly) comprising at least one latch 12/13 to engage with said receiver adapter (Par. 0048; (Fig. 5).

Selvetti fails to disclose wherein said receiver adapter comprises a tapered inner wall.
Hochstrate teaches that it is known in the art of barrel systems to provide tapered walls (Fig. 9; Par. Par. 0057: “Barrel extension 196 has taper 256 to center and lock barrel extension 196 in position and to increase the clamped surface area… As may realized, the tapered surfaces 256, 266 respectively on the barrel extension and barrel nut provide additional surface area for frictional clamping and cooperate to centralize the barrel due to the matching taper on the nut and barrel”).

It would have been obvious to one having ordinary skill in the art at the time the invention was filed to have modified Selvetti such that receiver adapter comprises a tapered inner wall, in view of Hochstrate, to obtain the desired result of providing additional surface area for frictional clamping.
Selvetti in view of Hochstrate fails to disclose to disclose or render obvious the combination including wherein the barrel adapter assembly couples to and depth ring and said barrel assembly has a tapered downstream outer wall. Furthermore, Selvetti in view of Hochstrate fails fails to disclose or render obvious the combination including coupling a barrel adapter assembly to a new barrel, wherein the barrel adapter has a tapered downstream outer wall; d. coupling a housing over said barrel adapter assembly to said receiver adapter.
Additional art representing the state of the art of firearm barrel systems considered relevant to applicant’s disclosure is cited in the attached PTO-892 form. The references alone or in combination do not anticipate or make obvious the claimed invention.
Any comments considered necessary by applicant must be submitted no later than the payment of the issue fee and, to avoid processing delays, should preferably accompany the issue fee.  Such submissions should be clearly labeled “Comments on Statement of Reasons for Allowance.”
